text: Entry Requirements Applicant shall provide high school diploma obtained from schools certified by the Ministry of Education of home country. High school diploma or the equivalent. Under the age of 25. Applicants shall meet one of the conditions 1-3, and meet condition 4. 1. The applicant's native language is English or the official language is English; 2. The medium language of applicants' highest education qualification is English; 3. International English language tests scores: Academic IELTS overall score 6.0, with all bands 5.5 or above; TOEFL overall score 85 with all bands 20 or above, or the equivalent; GRE score 300 or above; Duolingo scores of 95 or above. 4. Applicants must pass the English test after the registration.
